description: Measured task outcomes versus estimates. Wall-clock durations are derived from recorded ledger timestamps; token and cost data are not reported by the runtime and remain null.

definitions.actualDurationHours: Wall-clock span between recorded start and completion, in hours. Includes idle time and is not a clean effort measure.
definitions.tokens: Input/output token counts reported by the provider or runtime. Null when unreported.
definitions.costUsd: Provider-billed cost. Null when no dated rate exists.
definitions.estimateVarianceHours: actualDurationHours - estimateHours; negative means faster than planned.

records.notes: Duration is the recorded dispatch-to-state-write span, not a clean effort measure. The estimate included review and reconciliation.

notes: Null token and cost fields mean the runtime did not expose them; they are not zero.
